title: Return Credit Amount for Special Order Refunds to Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
**Amount.** The return credit posted on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account for refunds from Ridgeline Special Order Services is the uncredited refund plus a late-posting allowance, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Uncredited refund.** The total of the special order refunds issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name in the last 3 months (dated less than 3 full months before today), less the return credits posted on the account in the same 3 months, and never below zero. Both totals are taken to the cent before the one is subtracted from the other.

**Late-posting allowance.** The uncredited refund multiplied by 6 percent a year and by the calendar days from the latest of those refund dates to today, divided by 365 and rounded to the nearest cent. In words of the arithmetic: the uncredited refund, multiplied by 6 and divided by 100, multiplied by the number of calendar days, divided by 365.

**The 3-month window.** A refund or credit dated exactly 3 full months before today falls outside it; one dated a day later falls inside. With today 20 May, a refund dated 20 February is outside and one dated 21 February is inside.

## Worked figures (hypothetical ledgers)

| Refunds to the card tender in 3 months | Return credits on the account in 3 months | Uncredited refund | Days from the latest refund date | Late-posting allowance | Return credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 840.00 | 0.00 | 840.00 | 20 | 840.00 multiplied by 6 percent, by 20, divided by 365: 2.7616..., rounded 2.76 | 842.76 |
| 1200.00 | 400.00 | 800.00 | 45 | 800.00 multiplied by 6 percent, by 45, divided by 365: 5.9178..., rounded 5.92 | 805.92 |
| 300.00 | 350.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) | 10 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Basis questions answered

**Which return credits are subtracted?** Every return credit posted on this account in the same 3 months, whichever refund it came from.

**Whose refunds count?** Special order refunds issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name; refunds issued to another tender are not part of the total.
